component.name: YT Downloader
component.summary: Download videos and audio with AI assistance using yt-dlp and FFmpeg

description.p: YT Downloader is a desktop video downloader with an integrated AI Agent. It uses yt-dlp for downloading media and FFmpeg for formatting, re-encoding, and hardcoding subtitles.

ul.li: Classic Mode: Simple URL form with format and quality selection.
AI Mode: Natural language requests like "Download this video in 720p" or "Embed subtitles at the top".
Support for YouTube, X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, and more.

description.p: Release 4.5.1 with UI improvements and updated tools.
